Current scope

VARZIN is an independent computational research and reproducibility project. Current public work separates mathematical results, computational findings, open empirical questions, negative results, and historical hypotheses.

Human-study boundary

Project documents contain VPE-001/VPE-001A study plans, but no human outcome is established. Questions about those materials are welcome; recruitment or approval status should not be inferred from this contact page.

Correspondence guide

Help make a research inquiry reproducible.

For a correction or reproducibility report, include the exact page or DOI, the version you inspected, the command or procedure you ran, and the smallest artifact needed to reproduce the discrepancy. For a collaboration inquiry, identify the research question, the proposed role, and whether you are referring to mathematics, software, LUXVAR structure, model auditing, or the Cognitive CAPTCHA prototype.

Messages about historical VARZIN material are welcome, but older symbolic or exploratory wording should not be assumed to describe the current scientific position. Current interpretation follows the latest relevant Zenodo record and its version-matched artifacts, with negative results and superseded claims retained for provenance.

Security reports about the Cognitive CAPTCHA should distinguish a defect in the local MVP from a claim about production anti-bot effectiveness. The current public prototype is inspectable and is not represented as a secret challenge bank or independently validated security barrier.
